content.text: {"name":"issue_transition","description":"流转 issue 状态：start(open→in_progress)/resolve(in_progress→resolved)/close(resolved→closed)/reopen(closed|rejected→open)/reject(in_progress→rejected，必填 reason 拒绝原因)。","inputSchema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"taskId":{"type":"string","description":"任务 ID"},"selfInstanceId":{"type":"string","description":"调用方成员 id（tmm_ 前缀，你的成员身份，由系统提示注入）"},"issueId":{"type":"string","description":"issue ID"},"action":{"type":"string","enum":["start","resolve","close","reopen","reject"],"description":"状态流转动作：start 开始处理 / resolve 处理完成 / close 验收关闭 / reopen 重开 / reject 拒绝处理"},"reason":{"description":"拒绝处理原因（action=reject 时必填）","type":"string"}},"required":["taskId","selfInstanceId","issueId","action"],"additionalProperties":false},"required":["taskId","selfInstanceId","issueId","action"],"enums":{"action":["start","resolve","close","reopen","reject"]},"constraints":{},"stateMachine":["start: [open] → in_progress","resolve: [in_progress] → resolved","close: [resolved] → closed","reopen: [closed, rejected] → open","reject: [in_progress] → rejected"]}
